mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversations (user_uuid, conversation_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userUuid}, #{conversationId}, #{title}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_uuid, conversation_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT id, user_uuid, conversation_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_conversations WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversations SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_conversations WHERE updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
